items.raw_excerpt: A mathematical algorithm developed more than 60 years ago is powering FirstDate. Here’s how it finds “stable” matches.
items.summary_en: Singapore's GovTech agency has launched a dating app called FirstDate. The app uses the Gale-Shapley algorithm, a math method made more than 60 years ago. It matches people by looking at each person's ranked choices.

items.title_en: Singapore GovTech launches dating app FirstDate using a 60-year-old math algorithm

items.raw_excerpt: An Auckland early learning service has temporarily closed after alerting authorities to potentially asbestos-contaminated rangoli powder.

items.raw_excerpt: A Quebec train factory battered by years of layoffs is expanding as governments push to buy Canadian. Alstom's La Pocatière plant is hiring and scaling up for major domestic rail contracts, including a $4.7-billion VIA Rail project.
